entries.title: OGame

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Desktop browser capture of current service

primary.why: OGame is a long-running real-time browser MMO. The official Gameforge browser service is the content authority, while mobile access is a companion route for the same persistent account/universe style of play.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official browser service. Record country/community, universe/server, account/empire state, lifeform/update status, alliance, and date because the game is persistent and live.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service state changes by universe and update. Record server, account, alliance, and date.
